parameters: \bMr. Briney: Hold on, lass!\nWait up, Peeko!
\bHm? You're \PN!\nYou saved my darling Peeko!\nWe owe so much to you!
\bWhat's that?\nYou want to sail with me?
\bYou have a letter bound for Dewford\nand a package for Slateport, then?
\bQuite the busy life you must lead!
\bBut, certainly, what you're asking is\nno problem at all.
\bYou've come to the right man!\nWe'll set sail for Dewford.
\bAnchors aweigh!\nPeeko, we're setting sail, my darling!
\bMr. Briney: Is that so?\nYour deliveries can wait?
\bYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!
\bMr. Briney: Ahoy!\nI know exactly what you want to say!
\bYou're to deliver a letter to Dewford\nand a package to Slateport.
\bMr. Briney: Ahoy!\nI know exactly what you want to say!
\bYou're to deliver a package to\nCapt. Stern in Slateport.
\bWhat you need me to do is no problem\nat all--I'm the man for the job!
\bAnchors aweigh!\nPeeko, we're setting sail, my darling!
\bMr. Briney: Is that so?\nYour deliveries can wait?
\bYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!
\bMr. Briney: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!
\bNow, my friend, where are we bound?
\bAnchors aweigh!\nPeeko, we're setting sail, my darling!
\bMr. Briney: Is that so?\nWell, Peeko owes her life to you.
\bYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!
